ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture is a cartoon beaver/animal face composed of circles. A large yellow circular face can be seen, with one large blue circular outer ear on each of the upper left and right; in the middle of each blue outer ear there is also a small white circle; on the face there are two orange circular eyes, and below there is a purple circular mouth/nose. Reasoning: Counting by complete circular parts: yellow face 1, blue outer ears 2, white inner ears 2, orange eyes 2, purple mouth/nose 1. Adding them gives 1 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 8.
